name: open-record-test-d43d4bfeae/attached-functions-e
reason: This negative case asserts rejection of an invalid module-level attached-function declaration on a record and its use of self. Function/type declarations and the return/field-reference constructs are covered; rejection of invalid syntax and an unavailable self binding falls within that supported grammar/type system. It does not require successful support for record methods.
test_design_notes: Both the function declaration and return expression carry @error markers; the case asserts compile-time rejection rather than executable attached-record-method behavior.
